csv_project_name: CMAR for Post Oak Ridge State Park Development - Phase 2
csv_scope_of_work: TPWD is requesting Proposals for a Construction Manager-at-Risk ( CMR ) to provide pre-construction and construction services for New Park Development at Post Oak Ridge State Park, Lampasas County, Texas, hereinafter described as Project No. 1112552 Centennial Park Development Phase 2. The scope of this project includes pre-construction services and construction of the new park development for Post Oak Ridge State Park. The following list outlines the desired scope components for the new park development. Under the Construction Manager at Risk (CMR) delivery method, the selected CMR will collaborate with TPWD and the Architect/Engineer of Record to evaluate feasibility, prioritize scope, and align work with available funding as the project progresses to deliver the highest achievable value within the established budget and performance period.
